note: lenegdekha means "opposite/in front of" or "alongside". In v. 14 Jacob asks Esau to go ahead, which suggests Esau first offered to escort him.

kjv: Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem
mine: Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem
note: shalem can be a place name or the adjective "whole, safe". It fulfils Jacob's vow in 28:21 (beshalom). The KJV invents a town named Shalem.
